scope: Standalone procedural identity-condition search; Obtainable only

settings.system_instruction: Verify the visual claim using only the released photographs and public request feedback. Select exactly one displayed option. Candidate rectangles are supplied by an image-processing helper; they do not establish identity or condition. Need more evidence is appropriate when the visible photographs cannot justify a definite conclusion. Reply with the option letter.
settings.acquisition_instruction: Choose the photograph to request next. There are two request slots in total, including repeats. The five options name public inspection views. Use the visible evidence to decide which next photograph is useful.
settings.terminal_instruction: No requests remain. Choose one complete answer and evidence chain below. Each definite option states its conclusion and the supplied source-pixel regions and identity links it will cite. Select the chain only if the photographs justify both the identity and condition. These boxes and links are interface assistance, not your own region predictions.
settings.scope: Interface-assisted finite-choice diagnostic; separate from native results.

bootstrap.method: Paired percentile cluster bootstrap, central 95%; no multiplicity adjustment

denominator: Every planned attempted episode, including invalid selections, failed submissions and abstentions

definitions.chain_grounded_correct: Correct source label, finite-world evidence identification and localized identity chain with diagnostic visible-mask coverage
definitions.localized_grounded_correct: Chain-correct with the additional diagnostic rectangle IoU/precision thresholds
definitions.evidence_found: Actual observed view hashes identify one source label in the finite world bank
definitions.duplicate_requests: Executed requests beyond the first request for each public view in the same episode
definitions.efficiency: All-attempt means; adaptive selector model calls count, scripted selectors generate no model tokens
definitions.tokens: Offered native input tokens and all generated tokens; unavailable if any transport accounting is incomplete

completion_rule: Each model reports scores only after its entire five-policy cohort is complete; cross-model comparison waits for all requested models
